steps.label: Statutory Authority
steps.caption: Commerce ministry formulates foreign trade policy under trade statute.

steps.label: Dynamic Policy
steps.caption: Policy establishes dynamic framework supporting digital trade.

steps.label: Input Output Norms
steps.caption: Standard norms establish allowable duty-free input consumption ratios.

steps.label: Actual User Mandate
steps.caption: Imported duty-free raw materials must be consumed in own facility.

steps.label: Duty Free Entitlement
steps.caption: Advance authorization permits duty-free import of physical inputs.

steps.label: Minimum Value Addition
steps.caption: Exporter must achieve minimum fifteen percent value addition on inputs.

steps.label: Export Obligation
steps.caption: Mandatory export obligation must be fulfilled within eighteen months.

steps.label: Transferable Scrip
steps.caption: Duty free import authorization scrip becomes transferable post export.

steps.label: Zero Duty Capital
steps.caption: Manufacturers import production machinery at zero customs duty rate.

steps.label: Specific Obligation
steps.caption: Exporter must fulfill export obligation equal to six times duty saved.

steps.label: Block Milestones
steps.caption: Half of export obligation must be fulfilled within first four years.

steps.label: Average Maintenance
steps.caption: Company must maintain historical average export turnover alongside.

steps.label: Embedded Tax Rebate
steps.caption: Scheme reimburses embedded uncredited taxes incurred on production.

steps.label: Fuel and Power Taxes
steps.caption: Rebate covers non-credited fuel excise and electricity duty costs.

steps.label: Electronic Ledger
steps.caption: Rebates are credited to electronic customs duty ledger on portal.

steps.label: Scrip Transferability
steps.caption: Duty credit scrips are freely transferable in commercial market.

steps.label: Value Addition Check
steps.caption: Engine validates statutory value addition before approving imports.

steps.label: Obligation Ledger
steps.caption: System allocates export turnover to baseline average obligation first.

steps.label: Block Deadline Tracker
steps.caption: Automated tracker alerts corporate treasury to milestone deadlines.

steps.label: Redemption Package
steps.caption: Engine produces electronic redemption exhibits for license discharge.
